facts.text_en: Tourism Western Australia describes Mt Whaleback, west of Newman, as the world's largest single open-cut iron ore mine; the deposit was discovered in 1957 by prospector Stan Hilditch (Tourism Western Australia).
facts.text_es: Tourism Western Australia describe Mt Whaleback, al oeste de Newman, como la mina de hierro a rajo abierto de un solo tajo mas grande del mundo; el deposito fue descubierto en 1957 por el prospector Stan Hilditch (Tourism Western Australia).
